MV-IA-F013 Bounded Maps, Zones, and Tactical Positioning
MV-IA-F008 plus PPIA-03 Items, Equipment & Inventory Experience
8E-009 CSV-first Vehicle domain and vehicle parent reconciliation contracts
principles: Authorize and filter before vehicle existence, fields, counts, totals, rosters, system lists, route previews, provenance, history, exports, diagnostics, notifications, or AI context are serialized or aggregated.

Reusable Definition, source-backed variant/configuration, owned Campaign Asset instance, installed configuration, Scene deployment, live operational state, authority relations, crew/stations, cargo/carried craft, damage/resources, semantic movement, and provenance/recovery remain distinguishable layers.
Unknown or source-unspecified capacity, compatibility, resource, or system state is never displayed or processed as zero, unlimited, compatible, absent, or broken merely to complete a UI.
Ownership, custody, possession, control, station authority, passenger status, access, and remote-operation grants are independent relations.
Component Definition identity is distinct from installation state; name similarity and source-document grouping never create a parent or compatibility link without explicit evidence.
Semantic movement and docking state are authoritative; canvas pixels or geometry remain presentation unless a rules profile explicitly binds them.
Accepted movement, operational Actions, damage, and Resource mutations are atomic and server-authoritative; UI controls only propose or invoke governed commands.
Every operation has a keyboard, touch, and nonvisual alternative; drag, map pointing, color, hover, or spatial memory are never the only usable interaction.

visibility_classes.definition_public: Published Definition fields permitted to the viewer.
visibility_classes.instance_visible: Campaign vehicle instance fields authorized to the viewer.
visibility_classes.controller_private: Station/control details visible only to authorized controller scope.
visibility_classes.campaign_revealed: Campaign facts revealed to the viewer by governed state.
visibility_classes.campaign_gm_private: Campaign-GM-only vehicle, occupant, cargo, system, route, or provenance facts.
visibility_classes.transaction_private: Transfer, capture, salvage, service, or ownership transaction details limited to participants/GM.
visibility_classes.source_diagnostic: Source/conflict/provenance diagnostics limited by provenance permission.
visibility_classes.user_private: User-private preferences or notes never implied by Campaign GM authority.

field_groups.label: Identity & Definition
field_groups.projection_rule: Definition inspection never implies Campaign ownership, current crew, damage, Resources, or Scene position.

field_groups.label: Variant, Class & Configuration
field_groups.projection_rule: Source-backed alternatives remain separate unless governed identity evidence resolves them; same names do not merge.

field_groups.label: Component / Module / System Definition
field_groups.projection_rule: A component Definition is not an installed component and does not acquire a parent from name similarity.

field_groups.label: Owned Vehicle Asset Instance
field_groups.authority_rule: Ownership never silently implies custody, current control, station authority, or remote-operation permission.

field_groups.label: Installed Components & Loadout
field_groups.privacy_rule: Hidden installed systems are filtered before system counts, capability summaries, readiness totals, or comparisons.
field_groups.authority_rule: Install/uninstall never silently transfers component ownership.

field_groups.label: Deployment & Scene Placement
field_groups.projection_rule: Deployment references the owned Asset; it never creates a duplicate vehicle identity. Canvas coordinates are presentation unless rules-bound.

field_groups.label: Live Operational State
field_groups.mutation_rule: Commands are server-authoritative, expected-version checked, and idempotent; offline authoritative mutation is prohibited.

field_groups.label: Authority, Custody & Control
field_groups.privacy_rule: Viewer authorization is evaluated before control surfaces or controller identities are projected.
field_groups.authority_rule: Station assignment and temporary control grants do not transfer ownership.

field_groups.label: Crew, Passengers & Stations
field_groups.privacy_rule: Hidden occupants and station assignments are filtered before roster counts, vacancy indicators, readiness summaries, or AI context.
field_groups.authority_rule: Only explicitly authorized station holders receive station controls; conflicting commands resolve through declared command policy rather than UI arrival order.

field_groups.label: Cargo, Containment & Carried Craft
field_groups.privacy_rule: Hidden cargo, occupants, containers, and carried craft are filtered before totals, used/free capacity, child counts, search facets, or exports.
field_groups.handoff: Generic Item/Asset containment, transfer, and lineage inherit PPIA-03; vehicle hangar/attachment/deployment semantics remain PPIA-04.

field_groups.label: Damage, Condition & Failure
field_groups.projection_rule: Damage consequences are rules-profile bound; zero hull/frame does not universally delete the Asset or its history.

field_groups.label: Power, Fuel, Ammunition, Charge, Heat & Maintenance
field_groups.unknown_rule: Unknown or source-unspecified Resource or capacity values are never coerced to zero, unlimited, full, empty, or available.
field_groups.mutation_rule: Accepted Actions consume or change governed Resources atomically with their outcomes.

field_groups.label: Movement, Position, Environment & Docking
field_groups.projection_rule: Semantic position is authoritative; pixels, drawn distance, and visual overlap alone cannot determine rules.
field_groups.accessibility_rule: Equivalent list/table controls expose origin, destination, relation, movement mode, constraints, and valid commands without requiring map pointing.

field_groups.label: Provenance, History & Recovery
field_groups.privacy_rule: History and provenance are permission-filtered before aggregation, export, diagnostics, notifications, or AI context.
field_groups.recovery_rule: Ambiguous network outcomes require operation-status lookup before retry; successful retries reuse idempotency identity and never duplicate movement, damage, transfer, Resource spend, docking, or launch.

role_projection.player: May see authorized public/revealed Definition and instance state plus explicit owned/custodied/control/station surfaces; hidden vehicle facts remain absent rather than redacted aggregates.
role_projection.gm: Campaign-scoped authority may expose governed Campaign vehicle state and GM-private operational details; it does not grant unrelated user-private or other-Campaign data.
role_projection.assistant_gm: Receives the minimum authorized projection needed for the delegated task and cannot independently command, move, attack, route power, reveal, transfer ownership, or promote content.
role_projection.creator_owner_admin: May author/configure within explicit ownership/governance scope but source facts, Campaign instance state, and live server-authoritative state remain separate write paths.
role_projection.service_ai: Receives minimum necessary role-safe fields with hidden counts/topology removed and no canonical mutation authority.

transaction history retained

responsive_accessibility_matrix.expanded_large: Inspector may use multi-column system, crew, Resource, cargo, and history regions; relationships remain explicit in labels and tables.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.medium: Prioritize identity/operational summary, station task, alerts, and primary command; secondary regions collapse without losing state.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.compact: Single-column cards/sheets with persistent vehicle identity and current station; no essential hover, wide table, or map-only control.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.keyboard: All station, system, cargo, movement, docking, and approval actions reachable with predictable focus order and no drag requirement.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.screen_reader: Announce vehicle identity, layer/context, station authority, system readiness, Resources with units/unknown state, semantic position, damage state, validation errors, and resulting operation status.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.high_zoom_reflow: No horizontal dependency for command completion; tables convert to labelled rows/cards while preserving relationships.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.reduced_motion: Movement/docking/launch transitions use state changes and text, not animation as the sole carrier of meaning.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.nonvisual_movement: Provide list/table origin, destination, adjacency/range/facing/altitude-depth/velocity constraints and valid movement commands without pointer placement.

acceptance_invariants: Definition inspection cannot mutate an owned vehicle instance.
Name similarity cannot create mecha/spacecraft component parentage or compatibility.
Station assignment never transfers ownership; ownership never silently grants station authority.

Hidden occupants, cargo, systems, carried craft, routes, capabilities, and Resources are filtered before counts, totals, vacancy/capacity summaries, previews, exports, diagnostics, notifications, and AI context.
Unknown or source-unspecified Resource/capacity/compatibility state remains unknown, not zero or unlimited.
Semantic movement is authoritative; canvas geometry alone never resolves rules.
Movement, operational Actions, Resource costs, and damage consequences commit atomically under expected-version/idempotency control.
Ambiguous network outcomes use operation ID/status lookup before retry and cannot duplicate movement, attack, damage, docking, launch, transfer, or Resource spend.
Zero hull/frame does not universally delete vehicle identity, provenance, or history.
Detailed power-grid, Newtonian/orbital, full interior geometry, autonomous-drone/AI, and other IA-D08-003 deferred simulation features remain explicitly non-operational.
Every critical vehicle workflow has keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, and nonvisual alternatives; drag, color, hover, animation, or map pointing are never the only path.
